Martin is considered by others to be an unreliable individual. As a result, his ability to look after others has been called into question.

## History

Martin was hired to work at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) a year prior to recent events. During his time employed there, he lost four cows, the fourth of which died recently.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)_

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--martin.md)

Martin works as a hired hand on the farm managed by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). He has been employed in this role to assist with the farm duties and upkeep under her authority since the first volume.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)_
